marks.q: The Group continues to achieve a robust Adjusted EBITDA margin and cash conversion, both in line with market expectations.
Together these two strategic updates underpin more than half of the Group's FY26 revenue growth based on current consensus
The Group re-iterates the full year outlook for profitability and cash flow to be in line with market expectations
We are proud to report that we have exceeded the guidance we gave at our IPO, with our first full-year results expected to come in ahead of market expectations.
Despite a strong Q1 FY26, given that the financial year is still at an early stage, the Board believes it is prudent to maintain current market expectations for FY26
As a result the Company now expects that FY26 results are likely to exceed current market consensus estimates1 by approximately 10%.
Reflecting the strong first‑half performance, the Group now anticipates that FY26 results will be ahead of updated market consensus expectations
Although we expect some reduction in volumes into the region during the second half, at this stage there is no change to FY26 guidance of full year revenue of approximately £140 million

Excluding any contribution from the acquisition of Nutrablend, the Board now expects the Group's FY26 revenue to be ahead of current consensus market expectations2 at approximately £148m, with the EBITDA margin expected to be in line with current consensus market expectations2.

Building on the strong momentum achieved in FY26, the Group now expects total adjusted EBITDA for FY27 to grow year-on-year to approximately £49m (+13% year-on-year) and revenue to increase to approximately £205m, both ahead of current consensus market expectations2.

lines.text: Apr-25: “the Group does not expect the high whey protein prices to materially impact the Group's gross margin in FY25” → now “FY27 EBITDA margin is expected to decrease slightly from FY26 levels”, citing “significantly higher whey protein costs”
lines.span: First margin-down flag in the record

lines.text: Jun-26: Nutrablend “contributing at least an additional $30m in revenue at high single digit EBITDA margin” in FY27 → FY27 guide given only as “total adjusted EBITDA”, no Nutrablend split; FY26 EBITDA stated ex-Nutrablend but revenue of £160m not

Aug-25: net cash “is also expected to be ahead of market expectations” (£18.5m, consensus £16.6m shown) → Aug-26: net cash £15.9m with no consensus comparison; net cash dropped from the consensus table

Aug-25 next-year view was revenue-only and qualitative (“to be ahead of current market expectations”) → now numeric FY27 guide: EBITDA “approximately £49m (+13% year-on-year)” and revenue “approximately £205m”
